newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, quiet ahead of USDA report.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, quiet ahead of USDA report.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed on Wednesday in quiet trade ahead of a three-day holiday weekend followed by Monday's USDA quarterly stocks and prospective plantings report, traders said.
"This is a holiday market," a floor source said. "We've got the report on Monday. We're looking for plantings at three million acres. Anything bigger than that is going to be a bit negative."
Last year, U.S. farmers planted 2.8 million acres to rice.
Trade was said to be very quiet amid lackluster cash demand.
"There is no demand in any market," a trader said."
Rice ended two cents per cwt higher to 2-1/2 cents lower with May up two at $11.44.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 429 lots.
